description: Machine form of the TF-0631 rulings in docs/dev/architecture-skeleton/AUTHORITY-RECONCILIATION.md for scripts/check-semantic-authority.mjs. Bookkeeping of adjudications, not a source of truth for owner, default or authority: every entry names registry ids, records the values it was adjudicated against (so exemption-stale rejects it once a registry changes) and carries reason, reviewCondition and the document section it transcribes. Sections: exemptions (structural, X-01..X-05), adjudicatedConflicts (registered-pending-fix, C-02..C-06), gaps (registered, G-01..G-06), conceptAliases (I-4), authorityBindings (A-01..A-03). C-01 is not an entry: its reading rule is implemented as owner-namespace and is not exemptable.
